title: WorkerProblemDetectedPayload
description: Emitted when a worker identifies a customer problem in content. The problem is independent of product matching.

problem_statement.description: Clear, specific statement of the problem detected

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quote from the source that demonstrates the problem

persona_signals.description: Signals about the person experiencing the problem

problem_id.description: ID of the Problem entity created/updated
